name: BSP_Game_CallLuaEntryPointThreadSafe
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet mission_lua_host, read-only analysis; docs/MISSION_LUA_HOST.md. __thiscall(Game* this, const char* name, const ArgVector* args), RET 8. Fetches the globals from the LuaStateOwner at game+1A0Ch with 00b67980, looks the name up with 00b67800, tests defined-and-not-nil with 00b66200 and releases both LuaObjects with 00b67700. Only when the global exists does it copy the name into a native string and call 00887e50(0, &name, args, 0, -1) with ECX = [game+1A08h]. Used for luaStageInit and luaEngineMovieInit.
